deviations: The general web-search budget (200 WebSearch calls per turn, shared across agents) ran out partway through. Step 5 press searches were therefore run only for seqs 19, 22, 39, 42, 61 and 64. For seqs 25, 28 (only the general amendment-list query), 31, 35, 45, 48, 51, 54, 57 and 67 they were not done. A reviewer should run Hebrew and English press searches on each amendment's title or subject together with בג״ץ / עתירה / High Court / petition.

supremedecisions.court.gov.il was unreachable (connection timed out). The Nevo home page was reachable, but its case-law search (believed subscription-only) was not attempted. Step 4 therefore rests on Versa's site search, with the queries listed in each row.

The IDI site search is client-rendered and returned nothing. ACRI's site search returned only JavaScript fragments. mqg.org.il redirected, so archive.mqg.org.il's WordPress search was used instead; it covers mainly 2007 onward, so pre-2007 MQG petitions were not covered by step 3.

WebFetch cannot reach web.archive.org. Archived Knesset consolidated texts were fetched with curl and read in memory with PDFKit; the connection was intermittently refused. Sources used: yesod4.pdf (Basic Law: The Knesset, snapshot 20250414034713 of m.knesset.gov.il) and yesod6.pdf (Basic Law: The Government with the repealed 1968 and 1992 laws, snapshot 20260913094732 of main.knesset.gov.il). The Knesset legislation database itself was not consulted.

Most amendments' substance was identified from section headings in the Knesset consolidated texts, not from the enacted texts.
